title: Retain bounded exact forest histograms and subtract compatible siblings
quality_gates: public semantics and canonical tie order retained

timing_contract: Frozen source; one scored complete fit per arm on NVIDIA and AMD, counting bounded cache allocation, device routing, preparation and readback. Separate correctness/launch-log attribution runs; never time the fingerprint or mechanism fixture. Apple IDENTICAL is an identity witness only. Full feature unweighted count rounds and exact host-queue batches admitted; partial-feature, weighted, padded device-loop and uncached node routes retain exact fallback. Native builds explicitly bind device column and accelerator; independent host replay remains a separate identity gate, not a DeviceContext execution vendor.
